source.section: Form MO-1040 PDF p2 Lines 1-8 and 14-15, PDF p3 Lines 25-30 (instructions PDF pp6-9); Instructions PDF p8 Line 14 standard deductions; PDF p21 Tax Rate Chart Sections A and B; record base.deductions; Form MO-A PDF p3 Part 3 Section B Lines 1-9; instructions PDF p17; Reference Guide PDF p9; record private_pension_subtraction; Form MO-A PDF p2 Part 1 Line 17; instructions PDF p16 Line 17 worksheet; record business_income_deduction

worked: Single, age 60. The business income deduction is a Part 1 subtraction, so it lowers Line 6 and the income test: 23,233.81, under the limit, where federal AGI would be over it. Federal (given, not tested): federal AGI = self-employment net profit 25,000.00 + pensions 5,000.00 - deductible half of self-employment tax 1,766.19 (25,000.00 x 92.35% x 15.3% / 2) = 28,233.81. Federal taxable income = 28,233.81 - standard deduction 15,750.00 = 12,483.81 (federal senior deduction ignored). Form MO-1040 Line 1 federal AGI 28,233.81. Line 2 additions 0.00. Line 3 total income 28,233.81. Line 4 subtractions: MO-A Part 1 Line 17 business income deduction, 20% of net profit 5,000.00; total 5,000.00. Line 6 Missouri adjusted gross income 28,233.81 - 5,000.00 = 23,233.81. Section B: Line 1 23,233.81; Line 2 0.00; Line 3 23,233.81; Line 4 25,000.00; Line 5 0.00; Line 6Y 5,000.00, Line 7Y 5,000.00; Line 8 5,000.00; Line 9 5,000.00. Form MO-1040 Line 8 pension and Social Security exemption 5,000.00. Lines 9-13 federal income tax deduction not applied (not modelled; the household's federal tax is not an input). Line 14 standard deduction 15,750.00. Line 26 subtotal 23,233.81 - 5,000.00 - 15,750.00 = 2,483.81. Line 29 taxable income 2,483.81. Tax by the bands (0% to 1,313): 2% x 1,170.81 = 23.4162; total 23.4162 = 23.42. The chart and Tax Calculation Worksheet (instructions p21) round to the dollar and give 23; expected keeps the bands. state_agi (after every relief, as the check format defines it) = Line 6 23,233.81 - Line 8 5,000.00 = 18,233.81; the form's Missouri AGI is Line 6, 23,233.81.
accepted_approximations: The chart's cumulative amounts are rounded to whole dollars and the tax to the nearest dollar; the bands here do neither.
The federal income tax deduction is not applied (not_modelled).

The business income deduction is applied to all self-employment income; it applies to Missouri-source income only, and it also reaches Schedule E Part 2 income, Schedule F and Form 4835 profit, which the projection leaves out.
